profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Nationwide Financial
profile.summary: My name is Saffron Edwards, and I am a graduate of Iowa State University with my Bachelor’s of Science degree in Software Engineering. I have completed 3 summer internships at Nationwide Insurance, and started as a full-time associate at Nationwide in June of 2023.
